title: Worker BOS Deliverable Materializer Gate0 R2 Forced Contract ReadOnly

context.blocked_reason: Gate2 R2 has checks PASS but completed_deliverables empty and missing_deliverables 24/24
context.previous_bos_issue: R1 certified READ_ONLY but repository_evidence, deliverable_flow_map, root_cause_hypothesis, files_to_touch_later, tests_to_add_later and tablajeria_gate3_block_status were missing

mandatory_findings.repository_evidence: Map exact files/functions/lines related to deliverable contract evaluation.
mandatory_findings.deliverable_flow_map: Explain required_deliverables -> deliverables -> completed_deliverables -> missing_deliverables -> work_completion -> certification_basis.
mandatory_findings.required_deliverables_propagation_audit: State where required_deliverables are copied from job payload into result evaluation.
mandatory_findings.result_deliverables_creation_audit: State whether result.deliverables is ever materialized from repository/sql evidence.
mandatory_findings.completed_deliverables_rule_audit: Explain why completed_deliverables can be empty while checks PASS.
mandatory_findings.missing_deliverables_rule_audit: Explain why all required deliverables can remain missing.
mandatory_findings.work_completion_certification_rule_audit: Explain when COMPLETE vs PENDING_DELIVERABLES is selected.
mandatory_findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Give exact root cause hypothesis, not generic PASS.
mandatory_findings.files_to_touch_later: List exact files for a later mutation gate.
mandatory_findings.tests_to_add_later: List exact tests required before mutation.
mandatory_findings.tablajeria_gate3_block_status: Must be BLOCKED unless Gate2 R2 deliverables are complete.
mandatory_findings.fail_closed_decision: If any mandatory finding is missing, certification must be PENDING_DELIVERABLES, not CERTIFIED_READ_ONLY.

expected_result_contract.work_completion: COMPLETE only if all required_deliverables are materialized; otherwise PENDING_DELIVERABLES
expected_result_contract.certification: CERTIFIED_READ_ONLY only if all required deliverables are present; otherwise PENDING_DELIVERABLES
